summary: Poindexter's Palestine record rests on a Vote for Peace Ally rating in the general election and one recorded remark in which he characterizes his opponent Miller as 'fighting for Israeli soldiers to get the benefits that our military members get.' His campaign platform centers on cost of living, labor rights, and ending the Iran war to lower energy prices. The Ally rating and that single military-benefits remark form the basis for this assessment.
